scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:callable
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-qio --only firestore,database,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/database.test.js test/firestore.test.js test/storage.test.js"
scripts.test:callable: STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-qio.appspot.com firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-qio --only firestore,database,functions,auth,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/join-callable.test.js test/delete-callable.test.js test/manual-callable.test.js test/slug-callable.test.js test/dsr-callable.test.js"
